name: starlink-ghana-monitor
author: daveyhert <daviehert@gmail.com>
description: A Ghana-first Starlink monitor for electricity cost, data use and network health.

scripts.pack:mac: rm -rf dist dist-electron release && tsc -b && ELECTRON=1 vite build && node scripts/make-icon.mjs && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.pack:win: tsc -b && cross-env ELECTRON=1 vite build && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.release:mac: rm -rf dist dist-electron release && tsc -b && ELECTRON=1 vite build && node scripts/make-icon.mjs && electron-builder --mac --publish always
scripts.release:win: tsc -b && cross-env ELECTRON=1 vite build && electron-builder --win --publish always
